what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in Belgium, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8373 Eritrean refugees in Belgium, 1.5% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia and Sudan host the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea with EIJM - AS in 2003, and interstate armed conflicts with Djibouti in 2008 and with Ethiopia in 2016.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Eritrea.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2006 at 5 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belgium.
These are year-end totals for Belgium only, reported to UNHCR.
